title: Perfectoid pure thresholds of lifts of rational double points
summary: We study the perfectoid pure threshold with respect to $p$, an invariant of singularities in mixed characteristic $(0,p)$ arising from perfectoid purity. In this paper, we compute perfectoid pure thresholds for lifts of rational double points. We show that the set of such thresholds is contained in $\mathbb{Q}$ and satisfies the ascending chain condition. In characteristic $2$, all reciprocals of positive integers occur, and $0$ is the unique accumulation point.
